Native tagged binned fixture with explicit process physics/full gas molar masses/species map. Original numerical tolerances retained; PDF conservation integrates mass times dN/dr over explicit radius grid rather than summing untagged PDF values. Added independent per-species conservation at rtol=1e-12/atol=1e-30 where total conservation was checked. Rejection cases use native validation messages and additionally verify unchanged particle/gas arrays. Discrete energy oracle remains proposal-based and converts density transfer to extensive mass using volume.
